scope: all same-name variants in corrected UI/item/template intersection
primary_review: Sol directly reviewed fixed Git objects, all tier overrides, actual template bindings, execution-chain applicability and the current player examples.

content_review.tier_values: Eight implementations: I-IV 5/6/7/8%; Power Maul P3: 4/5/6/7%.
content_review.event_gate: on_sweep_finish; the actual source-slot held conditional is present, with no wrapper source-item equality or attack-type predicate. It requires direct hit count >0 and the Sweep-start combo snapshot >0; a delivered failed finish resets the independent counter to 1; recovery begins only when it exceeds 1.
content_review.sweep_accounting: ActionSweep snapshots living-character state before damage; a target killed by that sweep counts. Direct Sweep emits one finish event regardless of target count; pure push and WeaponShout do not. An actual push-follow-up kind=sweep can. Setup/activation, secondary explosion and chain lightning do not emit extra finish events.
content_review.recovery_math: min(missing toughness, current max toughness × the implementation/tier percentage); disabled recovery returns zero. ignore_stat_buffs=true excludes toughness replenishment modifiers.
content_review.switch_lifecycle: A slot switch retains the equipped Buff and counter while the held gate blocks events; returning resumes the counter. Actual unequip removes the on_equip Buff and re-equip initializes the counter.
content_review.examples: The two exact examples use Latrine Shovel Brute-Brainer Mk III and Power Maul Mk III, with source profiles/actions; first event from counter 0 does not heal, follow-up Sweep yields 5 at T=100 and 5%; P3 IV yields 10.5 at T=150 and 7%, and secondary arcs add no second recovery.
